title: Virtual reality based cognitive behavioral therapy for paranoia: Effects on mental states and the dynamics among them
limitations: - Items rated on 7-point Likert scales, limiting variation; - Conservative permutation tests limited statistical power; - No correction for multiple testing; - Baseline difference in one association unexplained; - Data missing at random assumption; - Limited sample size for network analyses.
notes: The paper reports network analyses using multilevel vector autoregressive models and visualizations with ggraph. The study was preregistered (ISRCTN 12929657). Code and data availability are declared but not explicitly linked in the text. The centrality test was not formally conducted, only visual checks and permutation tests for edge weights were used.
